title: Protect Cantrip-required built-in extensions
reason: Cantrip Code depends on its bundled bridge and theme extensions for authenticated worker control and appearance synchronization. Built-in status hides normal uninstall actions but does not prevent global disablement or every lower-level gallery, VSIX, profile, and uninstall path. The extension API cannot protect its own enablement or installation identity, so enforcement must live below the Extensions UI.
validation: Confirm cantrip.cantrip-workbench and cantrip.cantrip-themes cannot be disabled, uninstalled, downgraded, or replaced through Open VSX, VSIX, or profile operations
removal: Remove if OpenVSCode adds a product-level required-extension policy that covers enablement, uninstall, gallery and VSIX replacement, and profile import paths.
